# Investigate Bug

Investigate the described bug before changing code.

## What to do

- inspect logs, stack traces and reproductions
- inspect related classes and tests
- identify probable root cause
- identify affected flows and contracts
- propose minimal fix
- list regression risks
- propose tests to prevent recurrence

If evidence is insufficient, ask targeted questions.
